questions.question: What is the monthly rent?
questions.quote: The rent is 1,150 pounds per calendar month

questions.question: How much is the deposit?
questions.quote: the Tenant pays a deposit of 1,326 pounds

questions.question: What is my annual salary?
questions.quote: Your salary is 68,500 pounds a year

questions.question: How many days of paid holiday do I get each year?
questions.quote: You are entitled to 25 days of paid holiday

questions.question: How much does the company contribute to my pension?
questions.quote: The Company contributes 5 per cent of your basic salary

questions.question: Can I bring my pet with me when I move in?
questions.quote: The Tenant must not keep any animal at the Property

questions.question: My boiler broke and there's no hot water. How quickly does it have to be fixed?
questions.quote: within 24 hours of being told about it

questions.question: How much warning do I get before the rent goes up?
questions.quote: not less than one month's notice in writing of any rent increase

questions.question: I was ill for three days. Do I need a note from my GP?
questions.quote: For absences of up to seven calendar days you must complete a self-certification form

questions.question: Am I allowed to work from home?
questions.quote: at least two days a week

questions.question: What happens to leave I haven't used by the end of the year?
questions.quote: You may carry over up to five days of unused holiday

questions.question: If they let me go after eight years there, how much notice am I owed?
questions.quote: increases by one week for each further complete year of employment

questions.question: Can a friend stay with me for a month, and do I need permission?
questions.quote: Guests who stay longer need the Landlord's written consent
questions.note: Clause 4.2 straddles the end of page 1's first chunk: the fourteen-night rule is in both chunks, the consent rule only in the second (short) one.

questions.question: Who pays the council tax and the service charge for the communal areas?
questions.quote: The Landlord pays the building insurance and the service charge
questions.note: Clause 6.7 straddles the end of page 2's first chunk: council tax is in both chunks, the service charge only in the second.

questions.question: Do I get a company car or a car allowance?
questions.note: Neither document mentions cars. Its best score calibrates MIN_SIMILARITY.
